product_one_liner.value: Reveal provides AI-powered eDiscovery and investigation software that helps corporate legal teams, law firms, legal service providers, government, and education organizations process, review, and analyze case data.
product_one_liner.notes: Reveal describes its product as AI-powered eDiscovery software and identifies corporate legal, law firms, legal service providers, government, and education as users.

pricing_page.notes: The public /pricing page describes pay-as-you-go or subscription pricing, although prospects are directed to a demo form rather than published dollar prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Reveal’s success-story index names the City of Baltimore and Balfour Beatty in customer case studies. | named_customers.0: A customer success story is titled as a case study about the City of Baltimore using Logikcull. | named_customers.1: Reveal’s success-story index includes multiple Balfour Beatty case studies using Reveal.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 478 employees, which falls in the specified 201–500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company identifies its North American headquarters in Chicago, Illinois, USA; the city is Chicago. | hq_country: The company identifies its North American headquarters in Chicago, Illinois, USA.

founded_year.notes: Reveal’s company history describes Reveal Data as founded in 2008.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog includes multiple posts on the product’s deployment and storage architecture/performance, including technical pieces attributed to Reveal Team. The authors are not individually identified as engineers, so this is medium confidence.

public_docs.notes: Reveal’s Support page has a product documentation section linking to multiple product documentation sites, satisfying the public documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The subsequently fetched careers listing shows open positions but no AI/ML/data-science role; the previously surfaced Machine Learning Scientist listing no longer existed when checked.

model_provider.value: Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI (depending on region) for AI-Assisted Document Review; Reveal AI also supports customer-preferred models and infrastructure.
model_provider.notes: Reveal’s AI-Assisted Document Review page says the feature supports Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI by region; the company separately describes user choice of models for its agentic suite.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center names ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 in its compliance documents, and its reports listing names GDPR; the listed HIPAA report is not treated as a certification. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly lists ISO/IEC 27001 as a compliance document. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center explicitly lists SOC 2 Type 2 as a compliance document. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center’s reports listing names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: CB Insights labels the January 2021 latest funding round Growth Equity. | funding_date: The latest funding round is dated January 26, 2021, which maps to YYYY-MM 2021-01. | funding_amount_usd: CB Insights lists the latest funding round as $200 million Growth Equity on January 26, 2021; Reveal’s contemporaneous announcement describes K1 investing more than $200 million in the combined organization.

raised_18mo.notes: The identified latest funding round was in January 2021, well before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers board lists Account Executive, II and Accounts Executive I as open positions.

launched_6mo.notes: Reveal’s October 2026 product-update release describes newly shipped Reveal AI and Onna connectors, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Reveal announced on October 14, 2025 that founder Wendell Jisa would become board chair and Eric Harmon would become CEO, within the preceding 12 months.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Reveal’s Account Executive job posting explicitly instructs the employee to maintain a prospecting database in Salesforce CRM. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting explicitly names Salesforce CRM.
